//: Type-check gate for the shared browser client library (src/**/*.ts). Same shape as the console/docs TS gates: esbuild does the actual compilation in each consumer, this only drives the tsc run in `magus run lint libs/textsearch`. Tests are excluded so the gate needs no @types/node (the *.test.ts imports node:test, exercised by `magus run test libs/textsearch`).
